L1.name: Remember
L1.description: Recall facts, basic concepts, definitions, and formulas.

L2.name: Understand
L2.description: Explain ideas, concepts, classify information, and interpret meaning.

L3.name: Apply
L3.description: Use information in new situations, solve numerical problems, and execute procedures.

L4.name: Analyze
L4.description: Draw connections among ideas, differentiate, compare, and break concepts into parts.

L5.name: Evaluate
L5.description: Justify a stand or decision, critique, verify findings, and check validity.

L6.name: Create
L6.description: Produce new or original work, design architectures, algorithms, or models.

cos.CO1: Understand fundamentals of transmission lines, wave propagation and microwave waveguides.
cos.CO2: Analyze radiation mechanisms, antenna parameters and radiation patterns of dipole, loop and aperture antennas.
cos.CO3: Design microstrip antennas, antenna arrays and evaluate impedance matching techniques.
cos.CO4: Evaluate microwave passive components, resonators, power dividers and directional couplers.
cos.CO5: Examine microwave semiconductor devices, solid-state sources, amplifiers and oscillators.

cos.CO1: Understand time and space complexity, asymptotic notations, and array operations.
cos.CO2: Apply linear data structures such as stacks, queues, and linked lists to solve computational problems.
cos.CO3: Implement non-linear data structures including binary trees, AVL trees, and heaps.
cos.CO4: Analyze graph traversal algorithms (BFS, DFS), shortest path, and minimum spanning trees.
cos.CO5: Evaluate hashing techniques, sorting/searching algorithms, and dynamic programming solutions.

cos.CO1: Understand relational database models, three-schema architecture, and ER modeling.
cos.CO2: Formulate complex SQL queries, relational algebra expressions, and database views.
cos.CO3: Apply normalization techniques (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF) to eliminate data redundancies.
cos.CO4: Analyze transaction processing, ACID properties, serializability, and concurrency control.
cos.CO5: Evaluate query optimization, storage structures, and indexing mechanisms like B+ trees.

cos.CO1: Understand foundational concepts of artificial intelligence, search strategies, and knowledge representation.
cos.CO2: Apply supervised machine learning algorithms including linear regression, logistic regression, and SVM.
cos.CO3: Implement unsupervised learning techniques such as K-Means clustering and PCA dimensionality reduction.
cos.CO4: Analyze neural networks, backpropagation, and evaluate model performance using precision/recall/F1-score.
cos.CO5: Formulate solutions using ensemble methods, deep learning architectures, and ethical AI practices.
